findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "kevaremesh_use" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use when a task needs fresh web search/content, news, finance, blockchain or crypto data, social search, people/business enrichment, geocoding, travel availability, AI/media generation, screenshots, weather, research, or another external API capability. Put only the desired result in goal; KEVAREMES" → after: "Use for buyer-authorized Base64 encode/decode via the LIVE new x402 owned merchant (only if the current merchant release proof passes), and when a task needs fresh web search/content, news, finance, blockchain or crypto data, social search, people/business enrichment, geocoding, travel availability,"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
